question: In a joint military drill,________________ along with japan. Australia and USA held its first Naval Drills in Western Pacific Ocean in May 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Korea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The joint naval drills took place in **May 2019** in the Western Pacific Ocean, focusing on enhancing maritime security and cooperation.
 
• The exercise involved **South Korea**, **Japan**, **Australia**, and the **United States**, highlighting their collaborative efforts in regional security.
 
• The primary aim of the drills was to improve interoperability among the navies of the participating countries and to respond effectively to **security challenges** in the region.
 
• These drills were significant in the context of increasing tensions in the **Asia-Pacific** region, particularly concerning North Korea's military activities and regional stability.
